summary: All five nonduplicate Fe(110) endpoint VASP relaxations are DONE and passed electronic, ionic, normal-termination, chemistry, geometry, and post-relaxation duplicate review; IS-B and FS-A are the lowest same-composition states in their roles.

payload.objective: Review the completed five-candidate VASP endpoint set and select the reactive IS, lowest-energy reference IS, and FS for [CH][C][O]* + H* -> [CH][C]OH* + *.
current_evidence: Jobs 9725471-9725475 are scheduler DONE and all five canonical VASP relaxation result gates passed.
All final maximum movable-atom force norms are 0.0150-0.0193 eV/A, below the active 0.02 eV/A target; normal timing footers and electronic convergence are present with no fatal markers.
All intended C1-C2, C2-O, C1-H and role-specific O-H connectivity is preserved, and all five final structures pass chemistry-aware geometry review.
No strict post-relaxation duplicate pair was found among the five submitted candidates.
The compatible same-composition VASP ordering is IS-B < IS-A < IS-C and FS-A < FS-C.
IS-A has the shortest unformed O-H distance, 3.0797 A, while IS-B is 0.0310 eV lower and is the lowest-energy IS reference; FS-A is 0.1181 eV lower than FS-C.
Final structures, TOTEN values, force values, scheduler completion, and reviews were registered in data/project_registry.sqlite3.
payload.one_executable_step: Obtain user confirmation to use IS-A as the reactive path IS, retain IS-B as the lowest-energy reference state, and use FS-A as the product FS before constructing any GPU/NEB/TS path.
payload.submission_boundary: No GPU path, NEB, DIMER, frequency, barrier, adsorption-energy subtraction, or TS submission is authorized by this completed endpoint review.
done_when: The user accepts or revises the proposed IS-A reactive / IS-B reference / FS-A product endpoint assignment.
Any subsequent TS path receives its own path construction, continuity review, strategy selection, execution gate, and explicit submission authorization.
